cohort: The study included 234 women with a history of cesarean section performed more than one year prior to recruitment, attending an outpatient clinic.
finding: Cesarean scar defect (CSD) was found in nearly half of women with previous CS and was significantly associated with postmenstrual spotting, dysmenorrhea, and dyspareunia, with the number of previous cesarean deliveries and emergency CS identified as independent risk factors.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was identified as an independent risk factor for cesarean scar defect formation.
followup_time: more than one year after CS
